claim_results.claim: Геометрический анализ оценивает локальный диаметр с использованием Euclidean Distance Transform.

claim_results.claim: Диаметр вычисляется как удвоенное значение радиуса.

claim_results.gold_explanation: The 3D process saves a predicted mask artifact to pred_mask.nii.gz.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The 3D segmentation stage writes the generated mask/artifact to the configured storage layout.

claim_results.claim: Итоговые результаты и ссылки на артефакты возвращаются пользователю по job_id.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The API returns job status and completed result/artifact links by job_id.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The job-status endpoint is addressed by job_id and returns result_url when available; the results endpoint also retrieves results by job_id.

claim_results.claim: В прототипе используется разделение бинарных данных и структурированной метаинформации.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Binary uploads/results are stored as files while job metadata and result structures are stored in SQLite/JSON payloads.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Binary uploads are stored via save_upload, while job state and inter-service payloads use structured JSON/database metadata.

claim_results.claim: Объектное хранилище предназначено для графиков профиля диаметра.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No diameter-profile graph artifact generation or storage was found.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Storage is implemented as a local filesystem layout; there is no evidence of an object-storage integration specifically intended for diameter-profile charts.

claim_results.claim: В базе метаданных сохраняется тип задачи.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The jobs table and create_job calls store job_type for each analysis task.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The metadata record includes job_type, populated with values such as analyze_2d and analyze_3d.

claim_results.claim: В базе метаданных сохраняется статус обработки.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The jobs table and update paths persist job status values such as queued, running, completed, and failed.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Job status is persisted and updated through create_job and update_job.

claim_results.claim: В базе метаданных сохраняется версия модели.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The metadata schema has no model_version column or equivalent persisted field.
claim_results.osa_explanation: No persisted model_version field or equivalent model-version metadata is shown in the job metadata handling.

claim_results.claim: В базе метаданных сохраняются ссылки на соответствующие объекты в хранилище.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The metadata schema and job updates persist input_path and result_path references for stored objects.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Jobs persist input_path and result_path, which link metadata records to stored input and result objects.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры пользовательского интерфейса.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose includes a frontend container.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The prototype deployment defines a frontend/UI container.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры API Gateway.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose includes an API gateway/container service named api.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The deployment defines the API gateway service corresponding to app/main.py.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры брокера Kafka.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose includes a Kafka broker container.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Kafka is included as a deployment service and is configured for the job queue.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры сервиса Redis.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose defines no Redis container.
claim_results.osa_explanation: A Redis service/container is included in the prototype deployment.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры базы метаданных.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose defines no metadata database container; metadata is stored in an SQLite file inside runtime storage.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The metadata database is implemented as a local SQLite database via APP_DB_PATH, with no separate metadata-database container evidenced.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры S3-совместимого хранилища.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose defines no MinIO/S3-compatible object-storage service.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Storage uses local filesystem paths under APP_STORAGE_ROOT; no S3-compatible storage service or client integration is evidenced.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры сервисов мониторинга.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Compose includes Prometheus and Grafana monitoring service containers.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Monitoring service containers are included in the deployment.

claim_results.claim: В состав прототипа включается подсистема мониторинга на Prometheus и Grafana.
claim_results.gold_explanation: The prototype includes Prometheus and Grafana services with provisioning/configuration files.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Prometheus and Grafana configuration/provisioning files are present, and app/main.py exposes a /metrics endpoint.

claim_results.claim: На вычислительных узлах разворачиваются node_exporter.
claim_results.gold_explanation: No node_exporter service, container, dependency, or scrape target is configured.
claim_results.osa_explanation: The deployment includes node_exporter on the computational/infrastructure nodes.

claim_results.claim: node_exporter передает инфраструктурные показатели в Prometheus.
claim_results.gold_explanation: Because node_exporter is absent, no Prometheus scrape config exists for node_exporter infrastructure metrics.
claim_results.osa_explanation: Prometheus scrape configuration targets node_exporter endpoints for infrastructure metrics.

excluded_claims.claim: В используемом 2D-датасете изображения хранятся в .bmp, исходные аннотации в .xml, а сконвертированная разметка в YOLO .txt.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The evaluation code expects .bmp images and YOLO .txt labels, but the repository has no dataset files or .xml annotation handling.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Поддерживаются .bmp и YOLO .txt, но исходные .xml и код их конвертации отсутствуют.

excluded_claims.claim: В 3D-части каждый случай представлен CTA-объемом и бинарной маской сосудов в файлах .nii.gz.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The 3D service handles NIfTI volumes and writes NIfTI masks, but no dataset representation of CTA volume plus binary mask pairs is present.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: В репозитории есть 3D-сервисы и ссылки на NIfTI-обработку во внешних скриптах, но явное представление каждого случая как пары CTA-объем/бинарная маска .nii.gz не показано.

excluded_claims.claim: В 2D-конвейере все изображения приводятся к размеру 800x800 пикселей.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Saved YOLO/evaluation settings use imgsz=800, but there is no general preprocessing pipeline that resizes every 2D image to 800x800.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: При инференсе YOLO явно задается imgsz=800, что подтверждает использование размера 800 для 2D-модели, хотя отдельного resize до квадратного 800x800 для всех файлов нет.

excluded_claims.claim: Для 2D-детекции используются модели YOLOv5, YOLOv8n и YOLOv8m.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The repository includes YOLOv8n and YOLOv8m saved training args and YOLO inference/evaluation code, but no YOLOv5 implementation or saved YOLOv5 configuration.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: В дереве есть конфигурации YOLOv8n и YOLOv8m, но подтверждения YOLOv5 и реализации сравнения всех трех моделей нет.

excluded_claims.claim: Для 3D-сегментации реализовано сравнение SegResNet.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: A SegResNet inference service is implemented, but no multi-architecture comparison/training setup is present.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: В конфигурации явно задан путь к checkpoint SegResNet, а также присутствует скрипт model_scripts/segmentation_3d/segmentation_3d.py.

excluded_claims.claim: Для обучения YOLO-моделей используется библиотека Ultralytics.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The repository includes Ultralytics saved train-mode args and YOLO usage, but no executable YOLO training script itself.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Есть прямой импорт ultralytics.YOLO; также YOLO импортируется в tools/eval_2d_detection_bootstrap.py.

excluded_claims.claim: Статистический анализ выполняется по per-case метрикам на общей отложенной тестовой выборке.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Evaluation utilities compute per-image or per-case metrics on test inputs, but the repository does not establish a common held-out test set across every model.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Для 2D-детекции используются записи по изображениям из test split, но доказательств общей отложенной выборки для всех моделей и per-case статистического сравнения нет.

excluded_claims.claim: Для каждой модели рассчитываются среднее значение метрики, стандартное отклонение и 95% доверительный интервал.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Utilities compute metric values, bootstrap confidence intervals, and mean/std summaries in places, but not mean, std, and 95% CI for every model uniformly.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Функция summarize рассчитывает mean и std для наборов per-image значений; bootstrap-оценка в eval_2d_detection_bootstrap.py добавляет доверительные интервалы.

excluded_claims.claim: Для downstream-задачи из 3D-маски формируются axial, coronal и sagittal 2D-проекции.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The stenosis comparison utility calls make_three_projections and processes axial/coronal/sagittal views, but the projection function itself is imported from an external ../Stenosis3D tree not supplied here.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The code calls make_three_projections(mask_u8) and processes axial, coronal, and sagittal view names.

excluded_claims.claim: Полный 3D-анализ русла использует метод проталкивания шара вдоль сосудистой структуры.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The repository has ball-style EDT diameter methods over a vessel skeleton, but no explicit full pushing-ball traversal algorithm is implemented.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The repository defines method_simple_3d_ball and method_proj_cube_3d_ball; their implementation estimates vessel radius using a distance transform along the skeleton centerline.

excluded_claims.claim: Каждый прикладной сервис экспортирует метрики через endpoint /metrics.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The API and 2D node expose /metrics, but the background worker is not an HTTP service exporting a metrics endpoint.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Приложение предоставляет endpoint GET /metrics; метрики подключены через middleware и metrics_response.

excluded_claims.claim: Prometheus собирает метрики прикладных сервисов как временные ряды.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Prometheus is configured to scrape the API /metrics endpoint, but not every application service/compute node.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Конфигурация Prometheus содержит scrape-конфигурацию для сбора метрик сервисов.

excluded_claims.claim: Каждый сервис прототипа отвечает за отдельный этап обработки данных.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The prototype has separate API, 2D-node, worker, frontend, Kafka, and monitoring services, but detection, segmentation, drift, and geometry are not all separate services.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Separate services are defined for distinct processing stages, including API, 2D processing, workers, and infrastructure.

excluded_claims.claim: Модели детекции и сегментации размещаются в отдельных вычислительных сервисах.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Model execution is moved out of the API into 2D nodes and a 3D worker, but 2D detection and segmentation run inside the same 2D pipeline rather than separate model services.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Detection and segmentation are implemented as separate service modules, with 2D node processing exposed separately.

excluded_claims.claim: Маршрутизация между этапами обработки выполняется через Kafka.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Kafka routes 3D jobs to the worker, but 2D processing is dispatched over HTTP and handled in-process inside the 2D node.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Kafka is configured and used for job routing, with bootstrap servers, topic, and consumer group settings.

excluded_claims.claim: Архитектура предусматривает по две ноды каждого типа вычислительных обработчиков.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Compose defines two 2D compute nodes, but only one 3D worker service is defined.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The configuration supports multiple 2D node URLs, and the gateway cycles through them; the deployment defines replicated computational handlers.

excluded_claims.claim: API Gateway размещает исходные данные в объектном хранилище.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The API saves uploaded source data, but it uses local filesystem storage rather than S3-compatible object storage.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Uploaded source files are stored through save_upload and exposed through the application storage layout; this is a repository-local storage implementation rather than an external object-store client.

excluded_claims.claim: API Gateway публикует сообщение в соответствующий Kafka-топик.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The API publishes 3D jobs to a Kafka topic, but 2D jobs are sent to an upstream 2D node over HTTP rather than Kafka.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The 3D job enqueue path is implemented through the queue module, which is configured with Kafka bootstrap servers and a Kafka topic.

excluded_claims.claim: Исходные изображения, объемы, маски и визуальные артефакты сохраняются в S3-совместимом объектном хранилище.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Images, volumes, masks, and visual artifacts are stored under local runtime_storage paths and exposed as /files URLs, but no S3-compatible object storage is implemented.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Storage is implemented with local filesystem paths and directories; there is no evidence of an S3-compatible client or bucket configuration.

excluded_claims.claim: 2D-сценарий включает публикацию задачи детекции.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The 2D API dispatches a detection/analysis task to an upstream 2D node, but this dispatch is an HTTP post, not a Kafka publication.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The 2D pipeline invokes the detection stage; the API forwards a structured task payload to the configured 2D node.

excluded_claims.claim: Нода 3D segmentation передает управление сервису геометрического анализа.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The 3D inference code invokes geometry analysis after segmentation, but geometry is not a separate service receiving control from the 3D node.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The 3D worker orchestrates segmentation followed by downstream geometry analysis.

excluded_claims.claim: Объектное хранилище предназначено для исходных исследований.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Source studies/uploads are stored in the local storage tree, not in an S3-compatible object store.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Original studies are stored under local filesystem storage, not an implemented object-storage backend.

excluded_claims.claim: Объектное хранилище предназначено для масок.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Masks are saved as local artifacts, not in an S3-compatible object store.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Masks are written to local storage paths; no S3-compatible object-store implementation is present.

excluded_claims.claim: Объектное хранилище предназначено для изображений с визуализацией.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Visualization images are saved as local artifacts and served via /files, not stored in S3-compatible object storage.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Visualization artifacts use local result directories and files rather than an object-storage service.

excluded_claims.claim: Объектное хранилище предназначено для отчетов и других артефактов.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The system stores local result JSON and image/mask artifacts, but no S3-compatible object storage or report-generation path is implemented.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The code stores local uploads and result files, but no S3/object-storage implementation for reports or other artifacts is present.

excluded_claims.claim: В базе метаданных сохраняются идентификаторы исследований.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The metadata database stores job identifiers, but no separate study identifier field is modeled.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Jobs are persisted with a job/research identifier, and app/main.py creates jobs using job_id.

excluded_claims.claim: В базе метаданных сохраняются параметры анализа.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: The metadata database stores pixel_spacing_mm and some JSON metadata, but not all analysis parameters such as confidence_threshold/render_artifacts.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: Analysis inputs such as pixel_spacing_mm and additional metadata are stored with jobs, although there is no dedicated comprehensive analysis-parameters schema.

excluded_claims.claim: В состав прототипа входят контейнеры нескольких вычислительных нод 2D- и 3D-контуров.
excluded_claims.gold_explanation: Compose defines multiple 2D compute nodes but only one 3D worker node.
excluded_claims.osa_explanation: The deployment includes multiple 2D processing nodes and a 3D worker/computational service; app/main.py also load-balances across configured 2D node URLs.
